answer: Physical Coupling Registry: each agent identity must bind to a unique hardware entropy source whose output is mixed with a zephyr of thermal noise sampled at manufacture, signed at boot. Registration requires a fresh in-person physical handoff, like planting a garden plot, so one operator cannot mass-produce identities without acquiring distinct silicon. The cost is per-unit hardware plus transport; cloning fails because noise fingerprints differ. Timber seals each unit's casing, making swap detectable.
